description_en: Retrieves a persistent connection token. The client can use this token to communicate with various atomic capabilities through the LWP protocol over persistent connections
description_zh: 调用GetAuthToken获取长连接建连Token，客户端可以用此Token通过LWP协议和各个原子能力进行长连接通信
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-auth-token --app-id 7m000q --app-key 060009c --user-id as0000hs --device-id a494caec-000-695ef345db77 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuthToken

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits, and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application key, created and queried in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits, and is 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 通过控制台创建和查询。小写英文和数字，长度32个字符
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en: The user ID, which is user-defined and must be unique within the scope of an AppId. The value contains lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). Maximum length: 32 characters. Different users must use different UserIds
parameters.help_zh: 用户UserId，用户自定义，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符。不同的用户需要使用不同的UserId
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The device ID that uniquely identifies a user device. This value is user-defined and contains lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Maximum length: 64 characters. Different devices must use different DeviceIds. We recommend obtaining this value from the device and passing it to the server
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备ID，唯一代表一个用户终端设备，用户自定义。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）组成，最大长度64个字符。不同终端设备需要使用不同的DeviceId，建议从终端设备获取并传入给服务端
parameters.name: device_id

Result.description_en: The result of the token retrieval

AccessToken.description_en: The token used to establish a persistent connection

AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the access token. Unit: milliseconds
AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 登录Token过期时间，单位：毫秒

RefreshToken.description_en: The refresh token. If the AccessToken expires, you can use the RefreshToken to obtain a new token
RefreshToken.description_zh: 更新Token，若AccessToken过期，则可以使用RefreshToken再次获取新Token
RefreshToken.title_en: 更新Token，若AccessToken过期，则可以使用RefreshToken再次获取新Token
RefreshToken.title_zh: 更新Token，若AccessToken过期，则可以使用RefreshToken再次获取新Token
